implementation_summary: Added timeout.ts (AI_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS=120000, AITimeoutError, requestSignal combining the caller signal with a deadline via AbortSignal.any, and requestError mapping a passed deadline to AITimeoutError and a caller cancel to a DOMException AbortError with key-free messages). Each provider's complete() now builds the signal, delegates to a private send() holding the unchanged old body, and maps errors. The signal is passed to every fetch: anthropic:73, openai:76, gemini:37 (token), :144 and :161 (fallback). Gemini's resolveAdcToken re-throws when the signal was aborted instead of reporting missing credentials. The deadline uses an unref'd setTimeout instead of AbortSignal.timeout, because vitest fake timers do not control AbortSignal.timeout; behaviour is the same.

tests_proposed: Audit pipeline test: a cancelled audit passes its signal to the provider and frees the run slot (owned by the audit tasks)
Abort during response body read (res.json()) is mapped to AITimeoutError
risks: requestSignal uses an unref'd setTimeout plus AbortController and AbortSignal.any rather than AbortSignal.timeout, so vitest fake timers can drive it; same behaviour, documented in the file.
A caller abort now rejects with DOMException name AbortError and a deadline with AITimeoutError; callers should match on err.name, not message text.
A call that answers leaves its unref'd timer pending until the deadline (same cost as AbortSignal.timeout).
The Gemini ADC tests depend on test order because the token cache is module state.
MockAIProvider and providers outside the owned files are not wired.
handoff: Pass options.signal and options.timeoutMs (AICompletionOptions) to provider.complete/generateText. Import AITimeoutError from packages/core/src/ai/timeout.ts by relative path (no barrel export). Timeout gives AITimeoutError (name 'AITimeoutError', .timeoutMs); caller cancel gives DOMException name 'AbortError'. Other errors are unchanged. Default deadline is AI_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS = 120000.
